component.name: Encyclopedia 2000
component.summary: The CD-ROM encyclopedia, reborn with Wikipedia

description.p: Encyclopedia 2000 brings back the feel of the early-2000s CD-ROM encyclopedia, filled with today's Wikipedia. Read articles with pictures, videos, and sounds, explore the world on an interactive map, browse history on a timeline, and play learning games and activities.
It's free, with no ads and no account, and it collects nothing about you. Articles come live from Wikipedia and Wikimedia Commons.
